locations.note: One of the six real circuits licensed for the first Forza, raced as the full lap with the Corkscrew.
Offered as the full circuit and a shorter layout, then called Road Atlanta II/Short and later renamed the Club Circuit.
Licensed for the first Forza in its layout from before the 2010 rebuild; the newer Grand Prix layout only reached the series in Forza 5.
Only the full circuit is available here; the short layout was added in later games.
Licensed for the first game as a single full circuit; the sequel left it off the disc and sold it only as a download.
The full Nordschleife lap of about 20.8 km is the longest course in the game.
